findings: The book calls blue-cone monochromacy 'red-green colour-blindness'; that name normally means the common X-linked loss or fault of the red or green opsin alone. The lesson notes this, flagged.
The Embryonic Screening box is printed on PDF 106 and carried in this topic. 'release of clotting factors' is read as release clotting factors.
The book prints the genetic problems without answers; the worked answers in the lesson were derived for it and need the second-person review.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
